g.text: Feature Flags: Control Plane vs. the Evaluation Hot Path
Two paths through the same system, radically different volume
CONTROL PLANE -- a few edits per day, seconds of latency OK
EVALUATION HOT PATH -- ~200M evaluations/sec, must never leave the process
200M evals/sec entirely local: ~1us each = ~200 core-seconds/sec, spread across 10,000 already-provisioned instances.
The SAME volume through a network-called flag SERVICE would need that service alone to sustain 200M req/sec -- a bigger system than the one it protects.
Config changes propagate in seconds via a lightweight pointer + CDN pull, never a synchronous read against the Config Store.
